families.statement: Finite carriers, subsets, products, equivalence classes and typed emptiness.
families.boundary: Equal cardinality does not imply equal typed objects.

families.statement: Divisibility, gcd/lcm, factorization, repdigits, repunits and base representations.
families.boundary: Equal numeric value does not imply equal representation provenance.

families.statement: Prime factors, Euler phi and multiplicative order of base 10 modulo selected primes.
families.boundary: Decimal-cycle structure is arithmetic, not a physical cycle.

families.statement: Digit strings are interpreted relative to a declared base; 10_b=b.
Residues, residue-zero, phase carriers and functional remainder maps.
families.boundary: Residue zero is a valid class, not EMPTY_SET or TOKEN_VAZIO.

families.statement: Pairwise-coprime residue coordinates reconstruct a unique class modulo the product.
families.boundary: CRT coordinates do not establish physical independent axes.

families.statement: Remainder recurrences define finite directed functional graphs with cycles and basins.
families.boundary: Graph topology is not automatically spatial geometry.

families.statement: Composite molds and prime factors define a bipartite incidence graph.
families.boundary: Shared factor means arithmetic relation only.

families.statement: Z_m with additive step defines a cycle/Cayley carrier when the step generates the group.
families.boundary: Carrier period is not a cosmological period.

families.statement: Polygon and star-polygon molds use declared n and step k.
families.boundary: Polygon and star polygon remain distinct typed objects.

families.statement: Radicals, reciprocal pairs and exact/near equalities are separately classified.
families.boundary: Approximate equality never upgrades to identity.

families.statement: Numeric zero, residue zero, empty set, null, undefined and TOKEN_VAZIO are typed separately.
Mass conservation uses rho*A*v in steady one-dimensional flow.
families.boundary: Requires declared density, geometry, velocity and regime.

families.statement: Bernoulli and ideal Venturi relations are available under their stated assumptions.
families.boundary: Viscous, compressible and loss terms cannot be silently ignored.

families.statement: Directed edge flows induce node balances; zero balance is conservation, not missingness.
families.boundary: Discrete graph flow is not automatically a continuum fluid.

families.statement: Geometry, prime, graph and fluid families may become diagnostic covariates only after an explicit physical contract.
families.boundary: No numeric coincidence promotes a cosmological claim.

exact_invariants.crt_21: Z_21 ~= Z_3 x Z_7 because gcd(3,7)=1
exact_invariants.crt_42: Z_42 ~= Z_2 x Z_3 x Z_7 because 2,3,7 are pairwise coprime
exact_invariants.rep3_mod7_cycles: r -> 10r+3 mod 7 has one fixed point {2} and one directed 6-cycle {0,3,5,4,1,6}
exact_invariants.zero_not_empty: [0]_m is a non-empty residue class; numeric/residue zero is not EMPTY_SET, NULL_VALUE, or TOKEN_VAZIO

physical_boundaries.promotion_rule: Formal identities and graph conservation may pass independently; physical promotion requires a source-bound observable contract, units, boundary conditions, uncertainty, falsifier and reproducible evidence.

r3.F_ok: Set, number, prime, base, modular, CRT, graph, geometry, radical, typed-void and formal fluid families are implemented as bounded executable mathematics.
r3.F_gap: Physical fluid identity, continuum geometry, real boundary conditions, measurements, uncertainty/covariance and any cosmological coupling remain unbound.
r3.F_next: Run CI; after PASS, use the family manifest only as a preregistered feature/control registry before any held-out observational binding.
